##### Project general facts

Fairways 156 is an exclusive private residence. This architectural masterpiece features a double-height living area that creates a sense of grandeur and openness, with thoughtfully designed spaces that exude sophistication and timeless elegance. Every detail of this exceptional residence reflects a commitment to quality and refined living, offering a sanctuary of comfort and style.

The residence offers an array of beautifully appointed spaces designed for both formal entertaining and family living. A grand formal living and dining area provides an elegant setting for hosting guests, while the family living and kitchen area offers a warm and inviting space for everyday gatherings. The basement level features an entertainment and gym area, ensuring residents can enjoy leisure and wellness without leaving the comfort of their home.

Every interior at Fairways 156 is a testament to sophisticated design and premium craftsmanship. The double-height living area creates an impressive sense of volume and light, while formal and family living spaces are finished with exquisite attention to detail. The kitchen is designed to combine functionality with elegance, and the basement entertainment and gym area offers versatile spaces for recreation and fitness. The interiors reflect a seamless blend of luxury and comfort, creating a home that is both beautiful and functional.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within Dubai Hills Estate, this exceptional location offers residents a prestigious address in one of Dubai's most sought-after residential communities. Dubai Hills Estate is a master-planned development that combines lush green landscapes with world-class amenities, creating a serene and sophisticated environment.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to key destinations. Dubai Hills Mall, the community's retail and dining hub, is just minutes away, while Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah are easily accessible via major road networks. The community features an 18-hole championship golf course, parks, schools, and healthcare facilities, ensuring residents enjoy a lifestyle of convenience and luxury.

For those seeking a residence that embodies exclusivity, elegance, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Hills Estate delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can live in refined luxury.
